sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.40.1 Lua addon framework functionality stub
sources.notes: addon/ directory with complete Lua 5.1 architecture. Deterministic scoring logic complete. All game API calls are CIG_API.* placeholders pending CIG addon spec. Two-layer design: local deterministic scorer + optional AI provider commentary.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.40.2 license consolidation and redundancy cleanup
sources.notes: Removed LICENSE_CODE.md, LICENSE_DATA.md (covered by LICENSE and LICENSES.md), two developer stub files superseded by docs/ equivalents, and three thin docs with no references.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.41.1 new player setup guides
sources.notes: Added SETUP_COPILOT.md, SETUP_PERPLEXITY.md, SETUP_LMSTUDIO.md. Covers Microsoft Copilot, Perplexity, LM Studio, and Ollama. Updated README tables and SETUP_OTHER.md cross-references.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.41.6 scoring instruction accuracy fixes
sources.notes: Fixed Covalex alignment wording and Hull-B freight notation across all seven SETUP files based on full project accuracy audit.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.41.5 remove em and en dashes across all docs
sources.notes: Removed all em dashes and en dashes from every markdown file. Replaced with commas, colons, periods, or rephrased sentences. Excludes third-party .claude/rules/ files.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.41.4 README wording fix
sources.notes: Corrected 'open one panel' to 'focus one panel' in Hull-B cargo placement example.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.41.3 README what it does rewrite
sources.notes: Rewrote What it does section to lead with cargo placement planning and the Hull-B panel example rather than abstract scoring mechanics.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.41.2 ChatGPT no-project option fix
sources.notes: Reframed Option B in SETUP_CHATGPT.md to cover no-project and mobile app users, not just free accounts. Added scoring_config.json paste step for sessions without persistent file uploads.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.41.7 CI workflow working directory fix
sources.notes: Both GitHub Actions workflows (regression.yml and validation.yml) were failing because they ran tools and tests from the repo root. Added defaults: run: working-directory: developer to both jobs. Updated pip install in validation.yml to use ../requirements-dev.txt.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.41.8 validation workflow YAML syntax fix
sources.notes: Fixed pre-existing YAML syntax error in validation.yml. Two run blocks used unquoted inline python -c with Python code at column 1, breaking YAML parsing and causing No jobs were run. Collapsed to single-line python -c calls.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.54.2 covalex rank minimum load fix
sources.notes: Corrected rank mode to compute minimum qualifying SCU (total SCU x 0.26, rounded up) separately from full leg SCU. Output now shows full leg, minimum for rep, and space saved. Ranking updated to use minimum qualifying SCU. Stacking summary added: combined minimums vs confirmed capacity. Player workflow reminder updated. Handbook updated with minimum-load explanation and worked example. Synced to all 7 SETUP files.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.54.1 covalex rank strategy mode
sources.notes: New COVALEX RANK STRATEGY MODE in scoring instruction block. Trigger phrase activates separate analysis mode. Mechanic: 25% game threshold, 26% working threshold. Payout tiers: ~15% credits at 25-50% delivered, ~45% at 51-75%, ~76% at 76-99%. Per-contract analysis: extract all legs, calculate percentage of total SCU, recommend highest-SCU single leg, flag NOT VIABLE if below 26%. Ranking by recommended-leg SCU descending. Player workflow: accept -> load one leg -> deliver -> submit manually. Created player/uploads/COVALEX_RANK_STRATEGY.md player handbook. Synced to all 7 SETUP files.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.53.1 session capability gaps
sources.notes: Five gaps from live session: (1) panel state display suppression strengthened -- default suppress after first contract, one-line SCU total permitted; (2) capacity tracking added -- player confirms in-game capacity, AI flags at 80% and at limit; (3) mixed commodity same-destination rule made explicit -- permitted, each as separate row; (4) scoring suspension ACTIVE/SUSPENDED toggle added to SESSION STATE; (5) timer urgency flag added -- 90 min or less with 3+ stops triggers one-line flag without travel time estimation. Synced to all 7 SETUP files.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.52.1 cargo tracking overhaul and edge case guards
sources.notes: Full review of all AI-relevant files. Instruction block additions: number format normalization rule, screenshot text-only rule, terminal scrolling note, per-contract row rule for duplicate commodity/destination, player vs contract SCU conflict flag, panel reassignment propagation, ORPHANED cargo state for dropped contracts, panel state cleared on session start, ship switch handling, output hygiene rule. Updated playbook cargo ledger section. Added v0.52.1 entry to WHATS_NEW.md. Synced to all 7 SETUP files.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.51.3 cargo panel rules expanded
sources.notes: Full rewrite of CARGO PANEL TRACKING section. Added: one-destination-per-panel hard rule, drop-before-pickup hard routing rule with dependency flagging, destination overlap check on contract intake, contract swap comparison table, mandatory separate LOADED/PENDING PICKUP tables, SCU integrity rule (source-derived at every update), standardized contract intake response format, route sequencing rules. Added RETURNING to session phase list. Synced to all 7 SETUP files.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.51.2 cargo state tracking fix
sources.notes: Three fixes from live test session: (1) screenshots do not advance cargo state -- only player confirmation does; (2) planned panel state table now includes loads-at and delivers-to columns to distinguish mid-route pickups from departure-point loads; (3) explicit PRE-DEPARTURE / IN-TRANSIT / AT-DESTINATION session phase field added to SESSION STATE. Synced to all 7 SETUP files.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.51.1 hallucination guard expansion
sources.notes: Removed atmosphere weight override invitation from GENERALIZED_HAULING_HANDBOOK. Expanded SHIP ADJUSTMENTS in instruction block from 4 to 19 ships. Added non-flyable ship guard (Hull-D, Hull-E, Merchantman, Galaxy). Added placeholder issuer guard (Hurston Dynamics, microTech, ArcCorp). Added unrecognized location classification rule. Strengthened non-Hull-B cargo bay naming rule. Synced to all 7 SETUP files.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.50.2 atmosphere rule correction
sources.notes: Corrected overly broad atmosphere rule from v0.50.1. All stations (orbital, Lagrange, asteroid, platform) are in space. Atmosphere only for planet/moon surfaces. Ask player only when destination type is genuinely ambiguous.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.50.1 hallucination guardrails expanded
sources.notes: Added atmosphere/congestion/capacity rules to RULES, new CONTRACT READING section (field identification, partial screenshot handling, reward vs fee distinction), new SESSION STATE section (session reset, Available/Accepted/Delivered tracking, dead leg recalculation on accepted set change). Synced to all 7 SETUP files. Updated WHATS_NEW.md.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.49.1 cargo panel tracking rules
sources.notes: Added CARGO PANEL TRACKING section to scoring instruction block. Defines Hull-B 8 quadrant names, prohibits invented panel names, requires 4-state cargo ledger before every loading step. Synced to all 7 SETUP files. Updated Hull-B playbook panel section in both developer and player copies.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.48.1 inline session start in SETUP files
sources.notes: Added inline session start content to all 7 SETUP files. Each file now has a Starting a session section with the copy-pasteable session start block, hallucination reset block, and tips. All references to session_start_prompt.md updated to point to the inline section.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.47.1 score worksheet
sources.notes: Added developer/tools/score_worksheet.py: interactive CLI that walks through scoring factors and produces a score, recommendation, and factor breakdown using the deterministic scorer. Prompts go to stderr so stdout is clean JSON with --json. Added 2 smoke tests; total 191 tests.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.46.1 player changelog
sources.notes: Added player/WHATS_NEW.md: plain-language release notes covering changes that affect player setup or scoring. Distinct from developer DEVELOPMENT_HISTORY.md.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.45.1 player uploads sync tool
sources.notes: Added sync_player_uploads.py: syncs 5 player/uploads JSON files from canonical developer sources, comparing while ignoring the _copy_note field. CI check step added. Prevents player upload drift.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.44.1 scoring number validator
sources.notes: Added validate_scoring_numbers.py: 23 checks that all numeric values in the scoring instruction template match scoring_config.json. CI step added to validation.yml. Catches config-to-template drift immediately.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.43.1 SETUP sync tool
sources.notes: Added sync_setup_scoring.py and scoring_instruction_block.md template. Single canonical source for the scoring instruction block across all seven SETUP files. CI check step added to validation.yml. Prevents scoring factor drift.

sources.notes: Removed apeirogon.gg from README.md footer maintainer line.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.42.2 CI requirements hash fix
sources.notes: Fixed requirements-dev.txt to include hashes for all transitive pytest dependencies (iniconfig, pluggy, packaging, pygments). Partial hash pinning triggered pip require-hashes mode and broke CI in every fresh environment.

sources.name: Apeirogon Logistics 0.42.1 scoring completeness and checksum fix
sources.notes: Added cargo_panel_clarity (+8, Hull-B x1.15) and unloading_cognitive_load (-7) to all seven SETUP scoring blocks. Added UNRESOLVED cap (max -12) to match scorer behaviour. Fixed generate_release_checksums.py and verify_release_integrity.py to exclude __pycache__ and .pyc files. Regenerated checksum_manifest.json with 27 clean entries.
